name: ES Auction Hysteresis Escape v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: Cumulative volume-weighted value is auction memory, not necessarily a magnet. When price crosses the 09:30 cash open while the evolving session value center remains stranded on the opposite side, price and accepted value occupy incompatible states. Trading away from the stale value center should capture liquidation by inventory still benchmarked to the old state.

anchors.dynamic_session_center: cumulative volume-weighted mean of one-minute typical price from 09:30 through each completed minute

event_detection.scan_window: completed one-minute bars from 10:00 through 14:59 ET
event_detection.long_event: prior one-minute close <= cash open, current close > cash open, and current dynamic session center < cash open
event_detection.short_event: prior one-minute close >= cash open, current close < cash open, and current dynamic session center > cash open
event_detection.interpretation: price escapes across the cash open while cumulative accepted value remains in the abandoned state

execution.entry: following one-minute open plus one adverse ES tick in the crossing direction
execution.stop_fill: cash open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the entry bar touches the cash-open stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
execution.survivor_exit: 15:55 open plus one adverse ES tick

lesson: Price crossing the cash open while cumulative value lagged on the other side did not create an escape state; nearly every event reclaimed the cash-open stop. This exact away-from-value hypothesis is rejected. A fade toward value is an obvious inverse discovered only after the result and is explicitly prohibited from historical testing.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: fading toward the value center after observing the escape result
adding distance, duration, volume, or center-lag thresholds
changing the scan start or end
taking more than the first event
changing the stop or exit after observing results
